in_sanskrit.name: धक्ष्ण
in_sanskrit.meaning: धक्ष्णत्वम् (dhakṣṇatvam) - power, strength, ability, capacity, virtue
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धक्ष्णत्वम् (dhakṣṇatvam) - the state of being able to do, the state of being capable, the state of having power, the state of being strong, the state of being virtuous.

in_hindi.name: ठाकोर
in_hindi.long_meaning: धक्षता (dhakṣatā) - one who is endowed with strength, one who is capable, one who is powerful, one who is able to do.

in_tamil.name: தக்கோர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: தக்கம் (takkam) - the state of being strong, the state of having power, the state of being capable.

in_telugu.name: ఠాకోర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఠోజోపేటు (ṭhōjōpēṭu) - one who is endowed with strength, one who is powerful, one who is able to do.

in_marathi.name: Thakor
in_marathi.long_meaning: Thakor हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Thakor is a Hindi name that means protector, leader. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'thakar', which means to protect or to rule. This name is often given to boys who are expected to take on a leadership role in their families or communities.
